summary: CarMax Auto Funding LLC, as depositor, and CarMax Business Services LLC, as sponsor, entered into an underwriting agreement with Scotia Capital (USA) Inc. on July 14, 2026, for the issuance of $1,333,123,000 aggregate principal balance of asset-backed notes by CarMax Auto Owner Trust 2026-3. The offering is registered under a Form SF-3 shelf registration statement and is expected to close on July 22, 2026. This is a routine asset-backed securitization shelf takedown, not a special situation—no change of control, restructuring, or strategic event occurs here. The filing details contractual underwriting terms and a final prospectus describing collateral pool and note classes.
